gloss: lower level; bottom tier; low guard

definitions.gloss: lower level; bottom tier; lower shelf
definitions.explanation: The lower section of a shelf, display, rack, or other vertically divided structure. Used for furniture, storage, and page layouts.
In martial arts (especially kendo, judo, and karate), a defensive position where the weapon or body is held low. One of the five basic guard positions in kendo.

notes:
Composed of {下|げ} (lower) and ⟦{段|だん}→段：03424_dan⟧ (step, tier, level). Part of a spatial set with ⟦{上段|じょうだん}→上段：23042_joudan⟧ (upper level) and {中段|ちゅうだん} (middle level). The everyday sense (lower shelf/section) is straightforward, but the martial arts sense is culturally significant — {下段|げだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構|かま}え is one of the five classical guard positions in kendo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下段|げだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: lower shelf
- {下段|げだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place on the lower level
- {下段|げだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構|かま}え: low guard stance
- {下段|げだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to take a low guard
- {下段|げだん}{蹴|げ}り: low kick (in karate)

- ⟦{上段|じょうだん}→上段：23042_joudan⟧: upper level; high guard — the opposite position
